full_judgment:
2. Material facts of the case, briefly, are that the petitioners as plaintiffs filed Title Suit No. 14 of 1998 in the Court of Assistant Judge, Kachua, Bagerhat praying for declaration of their title in the suit land and perpetual injunction upon the defendants not to dispossess the plaintiffs thereto on the averments that the suit land under Kachua Police Station of Bhasha Mouza of CS Khatian No. 32 and SA Khatian No. 244, Dag No. 56 land measuring 0.47 acres was originally belonged to Asiruddin Mallik, the predecessor of the plaintiffs, that after the death of Asiruddin Mallik his wife Saju Begum, son Jabbar Mallik and 4 daughters namely Faku Bibi, Maju Bibi, Saju Bibi and Moina Bibi inherited the said land and subsequently, on demise of Jabbar Mallik and Saju Begum (wife of late Asiruddin), the said 4 daughters of Late Asiruddin Mallik remained as successor, that the plaintiffs (two full brother) having purchased the suit land from the daughters of Asiruddin Mallik vide two registered kabala deeds dated 13-1-87 and 1-4-87 and became for owner and possessor the same, that the defendants have no right, title and possession in the suit land but the SA record was published mistakenly in the name of some defendants and thereupon, the defendants claimed the suit land and also threatened to dispossess the plaintiffs; that the plaintiffs were not aware about the wrong SA record and due to this the plaintiffs did not face any difficulty but very recently the defendants have claimed the suit land disclosing that the SA record was published in their name and hence that suit. 

 15. It is also found that the plaintiffs in order to prove their right, title in the suit land exhibited two registered deeds namely Exhibit 3 and 3(Ka) and CS Khatian recorded in the name of late Asiruddin Mallik, the predecessor of the plaintiff-petitioners and also exhibited rent receipt vide Exhibit 1.
